description: This file defines an interface for accessing prayer times data from the Aladhan API, along with related data classes for parsing the JSON response.

classes.name: AladhanApi
classes.description: Retrofit interface for fetching prayer timings from Aladhan API.

classes.name: AladhanTimingsResponse
classes.description: Data class representing the API response containing status and data.

classes.name: AladhanData
classes.description: Holds the prayer timings, meta information, and date details.

classes.name: AladhanTimings
classes.description: Contains individual prayer time strings for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.

classes.name: AladhanMeta
classes.description: Metadata about the prayer timings, such as timezone.

classes.name: AladhanGregorian
classes.description: Represents the Gregorian date in string format.

methods.name: getTimingsByCity
methods.description: Suspend function to fetch prayer timings for a specific date and city, providing parameters for calculation method, school, and latitude adjustment.
